scope: Three deterministic unit cases mock Popen and signals; one POSIX integration case starts a real supervisor, child, and grandchild process to verify process-group SIGTERM delivery. No database was started.
behaviors: each child process group receives SIGTERM and then SIGKILL after timeout
an unexpected child exit with code zero fails the supervisor and stops siblings
a partial child launch failure cleans up processes already started
a real supervisor shutdown signal reaches both a child and grandchild process
limitations: The process-group integration case covers graceful SIGTERM delivery only; it does not establish forced descendant cleanup after an unresponsive process.
No database outage, lease expiry/recovery, provider transport failure, worker progress, or long-duration workload was exercised.
No candidate, legacy database, or Docker service was touched.
